title: Amethyst Suppression
answer: Amethyst grounds magic. Carried amethyst dampens energy and potency; powered wards cancel travel, fields and hostile casts through a spatial index. Place solid amethyst blocks exactly two blocks north, south, east and west of a redstone-powered ward to begin a containment ceremony: it progressively crystallises Darkness or Pure Light in a six-block sphere under a 256-inspection global tick budget. Strong clashes can still fracture ordinary wards.
